function: Iterative sparse Bayesian inference estimates cascaded RIS-assisted MIMO channels
note: Sparse Bayesian learning here is a model-based iterative variational inference algorithm fitted to each observation, with no training on data or by interaction.

function: Federated DRQN for task partitioning and resource allocation in satellite MEC
note: Learning mainly drives task partitioning in satellite MEC, which is above the physical layer, but the abstract does not say whether the learned resource allocation includes satellite link bandwidth or power, which the NTN exception would count.

function: DRL with convex optimization for association, UAV trajectories, offloading, resource allocation
note: Association, UAV trajectories, and offloading are above the physical layer, but the abstract does not say whether DRL or convex optimization handles the radio resource allocation of the aerial and satellite links.

function: RL preamble allocation for satellite IoT random access after collision analysis
note: Reinforcement learning allocates random-access preambles to reduce collisions, an access-control (MAC) decision rather than satellite power, subchannel, or beam control, and the core contribution is an analytical collision model.

function: CNN classifies human motions from LCMV-separated mmWave MIMO radar signals
note: Radar-only human motion recognition is sensing in a system that does not communicate, and the beamforming is classical LCMV.

function: IQIA-Net identifies spoofed 5G positioning reference signals from base-station hardware features
note: The learned network identifies spoofed signals from base-station hardware features to secure 5G positioning, which is physical-layer authentication and positioning, outside the seven areas.

function: Optimizes task and transmission resource allocation, quantization, model updates for UAV inference
note: Transmission resources are optimized analytically from a closed-form mAP bound, and the AI models are only the inference application the links serve.

function: Tutorial on key technologies for 6G standardization in 3GPP
note: The article is a tutorial on 6G standardization technologies rather than a proposed and evaluated method.

function: Meta-learned CNN selects modulation and coding for underwater acoustic OTFS links
note: The learned method performs adaptive modulation and coding, which is link adaptation, not delay-Doppler channel estimation or detection.

function: GNNs allocate spectrum and power to maximize radar SINR in multi-UAV sensing
note: The UAVs perform radar sensing only, so the learned spectrum and power allocation serves a sensing system that does not communicate.

function: SCA and PSO optimize UAV placement, DNN split, and powers for co-inference
note: UAV deployment, DNN splitting, and powers are optimized by SCA, particle swarm optimization, and block coordinate descent, and the DNN is only the inference application served.

function: Roadmap for edge-distributed maximum-likelihood localization in ICAS, possibly with deep learning
note: The paper is a roadmap that outlines planned research on distributed ICAS localization, with deep learning only as a future possibility, rather than proposing and evaluating a method.

function: Survey of AI and machine learning techniques for 6G networks
note: The paper is a survey of AI for 6G networks.

function: DRL refines UAV swarm positions; bandwidth-power allocation optimized analytically for JRC
note: The DRL agent only refines UAV positions, while the bandwidth and power allocation of the joint radar-communication system is solved analytically without learning.

function: Survey of beyond-diagonal RIS architectures, modeling, and optimization for 6G
note: The paper is a survey of beyond-diagonal RIS for 6G.

function: Potential-game UAV deployment, links, power, association with LLM-generated utility weights
note: Learning (log-linear learning of inter-UAV links and LLM-generated utility weights) serves UAV network deployment and topology, while transmit power comes from a non-learned gradient-based game algorithm.

function: BCD/SDP optimization of STAR-RIS phases, beamforming, time, power for WPT-FL energy
note: STAR-RIS phases and beamforming are optimized by BCD with SDP or Rayleigh quotient methods without learning, and federated learning with NOMA uploads, not over-the-air aggregation, is only the served application.

function: BiLSTM network performs scalable AP-UE association in user-centric cell-free massive MIMO
note: The learned method decides AP-UE association, which the criteria place above the physical layer as user association.

function: Optimization-embedded deep network jointly allocates subcarriers and power in Open RAN
note: The learned task is OFDMA subcarrier and power allocation with no multi-antenna precoder, RIS, or studied satellite link, which is outside the seven areas.

function: Analytical OTFS-based acoustic signal processing for continuous respiration monitoring
note: CORA uses purely analytical signal processing with no training for acoustic respiration sensing.

function: Deep subdomain adaptation recognizes human activities from Wi-Fi CSI images
note: Wi-Fi CSI activity recognition is sensing alone, outside the seven areas.

function: Sparse Bayesian off-grid DoA estimation with subcarrier-based grating-lobe suppression for ISAC
note: Sparse Bayesian learning here is an iterative model-based estimator with no training on data, applied to DoA estimation in ISAC.

function: Spike-and-slab support estimation plus OMP for massive MIMO-OTFS channel estimation
note: Sparsity pattern learning here is iterative spike-and-slab Bayesian support estimation followed by OMP, a model-based algorithm with no training on data.

function: DRL sets UAV trajectory and rendering collaboration; Lagrangian method allocates resources
note: DRL only decides UAV trajectories and rendering collaboration, which are above the physical layer, while resource allocation uses a non-learned Lagrangian multiplier method.

function: MM and successive-approximation beamforming maximizing mutual information for massive-MIMO AirComp
note: The AirComp beamformers are optimized by MM and successive approximation without learning to aggregate sensing data for inference, not models in federated learning.

function: SCA jointly optimizes sensing beamforming, device selection, OFDMA resources for private FL
note: Sensing beamforming and resource allocation are optimized by SCA without learning, and federated learning with digital OFDMA uploads is only the served application.

function: Alternating optimization minimizes FL training energy in IRS-aided cell-free massive MIMO
note: IRS and resource designs come from alternating optimization with inner approximation, and federated learning without over-the-air aggregation is only the served application.

function: BCD, SCA, and fractional programming allocate resources in satellite-terrestrial edge computing
note: The CSRA algorithm combines block coordinate descent, successive convex approximation, and fractional programming with no learned component.
